memories.author: patient
memories.text: Allergy: House dust mite – sneezing, itchy eyes, worsening of urticaria on exposure.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Chronic urticaria
  - Status: Persistent daily wheals, mild angioedema, score 6/10.
  - Plan: Continue levocetirizine 5 mg OD, add cetirizine 10 mg HS; advise cool showers, avoid known triggers; weight 52 kg, waist 78 cm (female cut‑off 80 cm). Diet: Breakfast – low‑histamine (oatmeal, banana); Lunch – rice, steamed veg, chicken; Dinner – light soup, avoid fermented foods.
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  - Status: Bloating, alternating diarrhea/constipation, abdominal pain 4/10.
  - Plan: Start mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 5 g OD, loperamide 2 mg SOS; weight and waist as above; diet per meal as above, increase soluble fiber, avoid caffeine.
Due: HbA1c not applicable (no glucose‑lowering therapy).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
levocetirizine 5 mg OD
cetirizine 10 mg HS
mebeverine 135 mg BD
ispaghula husk 5 g OD
loperamide 2 mg SOS

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
CBC: Hb 12.8 g/dl (12-16), WBC 6.2 x10^9/L (4-10), eosinophils 0.5 x10^9/L (0.04-0.4) slightly high.
Thyroid function: TSH 2.1 mIU/L (0.4-4.0), FT4 1.2 ng/dl (0.8-1.8).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Via app: Urticaria worse over past week, new wheals on arms after night shift; taking antihistamines as prescribed. IBS: constipation dominant, hard stools twice weekly.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Chronic urticaria
  - Status: Wheals reduced to 3-4/day, mild itching, angioedema absent.
  - Plan: Continue levocetirizine 5 mg OD, cetirizine 10 mg HS; add fexofenadine 120 mg OD if needed; weight 51.5 kg, waist 77 cm. Diet: Breakfast – poha, apple; Lunch – chapati, dal, veg; Dinner – khichdi, curd.
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  - Status: Bloating improved, stool frequency 1-2/day, occasional loose stools.
  - Plan: Continue mebeverine BD, ispaghula husk OD; loperamide PRN; weight/waist as above; diet per meal as above, increase probiotic yogurt.
Due: HbA1c not applicable.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
levocetirizine 5 mg OD
cetirizine 10 mg HS
fexofenadine 120 mg OD
mebeverine 135 mg BD
ispaghula husk 5 g OD
loperamide 2 mg SOS

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
CBC: Hb 13.0 g/dl, WBC 5.9 x10^9/L, eosinophils 0.3 x10^9/L (within normal).
Stool routine: Ova/cyst nil, pus cells 0-1/hpf, normal consistency.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Thyroid ultrasound: Bilateral lobes normal size, no nodules, normal vascularity.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Refer to Dermatology, Bangalore Medical College for evaluation of chronic urticaria refractory to second‑gen antihistamines; consider omalizumab.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Dermatology review: Chronic idiopathic urticaria, symptom score improved with current regimen; advise continue antihistamines, add montelukast 10 mg HS if needed; no biologics indicated at present.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Chronic urticaria
  - Status: Minimal wheals (<1/day), no angioedema, well controlled.
  - Plan: Continue levocetirizine OD, cetirizine HS; consider tapering fexofenadine; weight 51 kg, waist 76 cm. Diet: Breakfast – idli, sambar; Lunch – rice, rasam, veg; Dinner – vegetable pulao, curd.
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  - Status: Asymptomatic, regular soft stools, no bloating.
  - Plan: Continue mebeverine BD, ispaghula husk OD; loperamide PRN; weight/waist as above; diet per meal as above, maintain fiber.
Due: HbA1c not applicable.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: tTG-IgA: Negative (<4 U/ml, negative <7). No evidence of coeliac disease.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Chronic urticaria
  - Status: Free of wheals for past 4 weeks.
  - Plan: Attempt antihistamine taper – stop cetirizine HS, continue levocetirizine OD; monitor; weight 50.8 kg, waist 75 cm. Diet: Breakfast – upma, orange; Lunch – chapati, curd, veg; Dinner – lemon rice, stir‑fried tofu.
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  - Status: Symptom‑free.
  - Plan: Continue mebeverine BD, ispaghula husk OD; loperamide PRN; weight/waist as above; diet per meal as above, maintain hydration.
Due: HbA1c not applicable.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: CBC: Hb 13.2 g/dl, WBC 6.0 x10^9/L, eosinophils 0.2 x10^9/L (normal).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Chronic urticaria
  - Status: No wheals off cetirizine, levocetirizine OD only; occasional mild itching after stress.
  - Plan: Continue levocetirizine 5 mg OD; consider trial off antihistamine in 4 weeks if stable; weight 50.5 kg, waist 74 cm. Diet: Breakfast – dosa, chutney; Lunch – rice, sambar, veg; Dinner – khichdi, buttermilk.
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  - Status: No abdominal pain, regular bowel movements.
  - Plan: Continue mebeverine BD, ispaghula husk OD; loperamide PRN; weight/waist as above; diet per meal as above, maintain regular meals.
Due: HbA1c not applicable.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for follow‑up endocrinology review on 2026-05-15 at 10:30 am with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Chronic urticaria
  - Status: Off levocetirizine for 2 weeks, no recurrence of wheals.
  - Plan: Discontinue levocetirizine; advise rescue cetirizine 10 mg HS if needed; weight 50.2 kg, waist 73 cm. Diet: Breakfast – poha, peanuts; Lunch – chapati, dal, veg; Dinner – vegetable biryani, raita.
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  - Status: Asymptomatic.
  - Plan: Continue mebeverine BD, ispaghula husk OD; loperamide PRN; weight/waist as above; diet per meal as above, maintain regular meals.
Due: HbA1c not applicable.
